desc: Simple leather boots — a perfect fit.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x3、细线 x6、树脂 x2、菌丝体（材料） x15

desc: A comfortable, traditional garb suiting an upcoming alchemist.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x5、细线 x5、骨粉 x7、金属碎料 x2、活性菌丝 x25

desc: Starting out on the path of the alchemist apprentice, these gloves will make your life a little more comfortable.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x2、细线 x4、骨粉 x2、金属碎料 x1、充气女妖凝胶 x2

desc: Providing general protection and shade, the alchemist's apprentice hat is perfect for wandering around the world.
ingredients_zh: 骨粉 x2、破布 x2、细线 x1、金属碎料 x1、充气女妖凝胶 x2

desc: Comfortable trousers for long walks.
ingredients_zh: 骨粉 x4、细线 x2、破布 x2、雾瘴液体 x5

desc: These boots were made by the most talented cobblers and are as expensive as they come.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x2、堕落镰刃之雾 x2

desc: A truly spirited garb for magicians and casters. The fabric was laboriously dyed with deep cobalt pigment derived from imported nightblooms.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x6、衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x7、化石骨 x3、堕落之心 x1

desc: Gloves which were worn by the most talented, renowned and successful mages of the kingdom.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x2、化石骨 x2、黄色布料 x2、衬垫 x2、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: This magical hat was decorated with fine metal spines that reach out to the stars. It only graces the brightest minds in Embervale!
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x3、黄色布料 x1、衬垫 x1、堕落之心 x1

desc: The pants are elegantly held together with cobalt stitching and thread. The color represents sophistication and the superiority of the mind.
ingredients_zh: 衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x4、雾霭沙 x25

desc: A metal crown, coursing with electrifying energy. Wearing it makes the hair on your body stand up.
A silver helmet that increases your maximum oxygen while diving. Its delicate engraved lines imitate the flow of water, and the viewport is segmented like a clam's shell.
ingredients_zh: 海蓝宝石 x4、钢锭 x6、玻璃 x4、金锭 x2、金币 x10

desc: A pair of boots that has been reinforced with Drak paraphernalia, granting you the upper hand in combat.
The design of these boots imitates the skin of wyverns. Their scales were rumored to have the exceptional ability to absorb magical energy from all around!
This armor was conceived to restrain and control the wearer's smoldering magical energy within. If worn by a mere apprentice rather than an elder, it could make their heart stop!
All the forgotten knowledge of the world will be at your fingertips with these highly sought - after gloves.
The past, present, and future all unfold in front of your eyes like blooming aureolins when observed through this helmet.
Magnificent pants, word by the most battle hardened and sagacious wizards.
Gauntlets that burn with pure, magical fire. Use them to set your foes aflame!
obtain: is found at Gateway Outpost "Endflame", lore note on the west side next to a repair station will guide you to find this item.

desc: A pair of gauntlets that are as cold as snow on a sunless eve. Use them to freeze the hearts of your enemies!
obtain: You'll find the lore note in a building in the center of Goldrock Saddle on the second floor, that will guide you to find the located at the bottom of Lacemaker Pond from a corpse. You will need armor with Frost Resistance to reach the corpse.

desc: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x2、动物毛皮 x1、细线 x2

desc: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x2、破布 x1、动物毛皮 x3、金属碎料 x2

desc: Simple but reliable protection for hands.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x2、金属碎料 x2、细线 x1

desc: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x1、动物毛皮 x1、细线 x2

desc: A little archaic, but better than cloth.
ingredients_zh: 破布 x1、动物毛皮 x2、细线 x2、金属碎料 x1

desc: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.
ingredients_zh: 紫罗兰布料 x4、保暖衬垫 x2、紫水晶 x2、硬化皮革 x1、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.
ingredients_zh: 紫罗兰布料 x3、紫水晶 x3、保暖衬垫 x5、煤炭 x4、青铜锭 x2、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.
ingredients_zh: 紫罗兰布料 x2、黄色布料 x2、保暖衬垫 x2、煤炭 x3、钢锭 x1、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.
ingredients_zh: 紫水晶 x3、保暖衬垫 x1、煤炭 x3、钢锭 x1、雾锁独眼巨人之眼 x1

desc: Dark padded pants with golden seams. They're warm and comfortable.
ingredients_zh: 紫罗兰布料 x3、煤炭 x1、保暖衬垫 x4、钢锭 x3、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.
ingredients_zh: 骨头 x2、亚麻布 x4、干燥毛皮 x2、发光粉尘 x1、易碎瘴气花瓣 x1

desc: These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds in a pinch.
ingredients_zh: 干燥毛皮 x2、亚麻布 x6、琥珀 x4、雾霭囊 x2

desc: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.
ingredients_zh: 干燥毛皮 x2、发光粉尘 x1、琥珀 x2、亚麻布 x2、虫粉 x2

desc: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.
ingredients_zh: 干燥毛皮 x3、琥珀 x4、亚麻布 x8、骨头 x2、雾瘴蘑菇 x5

desc: A breathable tunic with ample space for bandages, herbs, and tissues.
ingredients_zh: 金属板 x2、破布 x10、琥珀 x5、亚麻布 x5、巨型生物鳞片 x3

desc: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots !
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、皮革 x2、青铜锭 x1、腐蚀之血 x3

desc: These fingerless gloves allow the weaver to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、皮革 x2、化石骨 x4、小动物腺体 x6

desc: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is suprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、皮革 x2、化石骨 x2、雾瘴凝胶 x5

desc: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、皮革 x4、化石骨 x3、酸性菌丝 x15

desc: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x10、青铜锭 x1、化石骨 x3、皮革 x4、木炭 x2、迷雾粘合剂 x3

desc: Light boots. They're slightly pointed at the toes.
ingredients_zh: 干燥毛皮 x2、破布 x2、靛蓝植物 x1、亚麻布 x4、易碎瘴气花瓣 x1

desc: This garment is held together by oakwood buttons, a woven belt, and magic itself! The buttons are doing most of the work, though.
ingredients_zh: 靛蓝植物 x3、破布 x10、亚麻布 x10、琥珀 x6、巨型生物鳞片 x3

desc: Artificial nails were added to these otherwise simple mage gloves to make them more imposing and fashionable.
ingredients_zh: 靛蓝植物 x2、破布 x6、亚麻布 x6、琥珀 x4、雾霭囊 x1

desc: No mage armor set is complete without a large, brimmed hat.
ingredients_zh: 琥珀 x2、破布 x4、靛蓝植物 x1、亚麻布 x2、虫粉 x2

desc: These comfortable and plain pants are perfect for apprentices who wish to gather some firsthand adventuring experience.
ingredients_zh: 靛蓝植物 x2、破布 x8、亚麻布 x8、琥珀 x2、雾瘴蘑菇 x5

desc: Low - cut shoes. Exposing one's ankles is quite enchanting !
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x4、薄荷蘑菇肉 x4、皮革 x2、破布 x2、腐蚀之血 x3

desc: An ordinary shirt, covered partially by a more sophisticated jacket.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x10、薄荷蘑菇肉 x5、破布 x10、化石骨 x5、氨腺 x1

desc: A magician's gloves, bound by a magic - infused golden thread.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、皮革 x1、破布 x6、薄荷蘑菇肉 x4、小动物腺体 x6

desc: This magician's headgear frames the wearer's face with a luscious golden trim.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x2、薄荷蘑菇肉 x2、破布 x4、雾瘴凝胶 x5

desc: These pants were made from silky smooth cloth, gracing only the most esteemed magicians.
ingredients_zh: 亚麻布 x6、薄荷蘑菇肉 x4、破布 x6

desc: A miner's helmet with an attached light.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x2、水下发光植物 x5、钢锭 x2、微光根粉尘 x5、海蓝宝石 x5

desc: Elegant boots with blue accents. They exude glamour and grace.
An exquisite mystical coat made of fine, dyed material. The metal clasps alone are highly valuable.
Mystical gloves that have been adorned with glistening aquamarine stones.
A Wizard Hat. Most commonly worn during lunar ceremonies and divinations.
A pair of proper trousers. The metal delicate accents around the waist resembles the moon and the tide.

Unknown footprints in the mud are always a bad omen, whether one is superstitious or not.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x5、巨兽肋骨 x1、亚麻布 x1、青铜锭 x2

desc:
An ordinary leather coat. A fungal growth overtook the flat grain texture.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x8、巨兽肋骨 x2、青铜锭 x4、皮革 x4

desc: Gloves made from rotting, undead matter. They claw at their wearer's upper arms as if to grow upwards.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x5、巨兽肋骨 x1、青铜锭 x2、亚麻布 x2

desc:
A living shell to encase the wearer's face like an iron maiden.

Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x4、巨兽肋骨 x1、青铜锭 x1、皮革 x1

desc: Dark chestnut-colored pants. They're less frayed and battered than the remainder of the Omen's armor. Offers extended protection against the Shroud.
ingredients_zh: 小动物腺体 x6、巨兽肋骨 x2、亚麻布 x3、青铜锭 x3

desc: Tied dark leather boots with quilted fabric sections. They reach up to the wearer's knees, protecting the shins from deep snow.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、银锭 x1、煤炭 x1、甲壳粉 x25

desc: It's an expertly layered blue coat with a white fur trim. The quilted cloth and leather provide better protection in close combat. The gold casing near the heart carries a faceted gem and resembles a cornflower blue eye, searching the battlefield for souls in need.
ingredients_zh: 紫水晶 x15、煤炭 x3、保暖衬垫 x4、银锭 x3、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: With these padded gloves, you can easily scale any cliff to reach snowed-in souls in need
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x4、保暖衬垫 x2、银锭 x4、紫水晶 x6、甲壳粉 x25

desc: When wounded warriors see this hat peak up from the horizon, they know salvation is near. Then they notice that the hat is a little bit cone-shaped. They usually don't say anything about it, though.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x1、银锭 x1、煤炭 x1、紫水晶 x5、甲壳粉 x25

desc: A pair of warm pants, tinged in a deep blue. It provides ample protection from the elements.
ingredients_zh: 煤炭 x4、保暖衬垫 x4、银锭 x4、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: They can barely be called boots.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x2、破布 x3

desc: Enough to brace for the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.
ingredients_zh: 细线 x2、破布 x2

desc: Can this even be called a shirt?
ingredients_zh: 细线 x3、破布 x4

desc: Comfortable and modest shoes for lounging in library.
ingredients_zh: 黄色布料 x2、衬垫 x2、青铜锭 x1、堕落镰刃之雾 x1

desc: In old times these gloves were worn by the wisest scholars of the kingdom, often hiding wrinkled and gray flesh underneath.
ingredients_zh: 化石骨 x2、青铜锭 x2、青金石 x10、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: You can't read sacred scrolls if you can't see, but true understanding comes from within, anyway.
ingredients_zh: 青铜锭 x1、青金石 x5、堕落之心 x1

desc: Remarkable pants. What makes them remarkable? The weaver, mostly.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x2、黄色布料 x4、衬垫 x4、雾霭沙 x25

desc: An illustrious garb that almost shines brighter than the wearer's spirit.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x3、化石骨 x3、黄色布料 x4、衬垫 x4、堕落之心 x1

desc: Ground yourself, and feel the earth beneath your feet. Connect to the magical core of the world with these graceful boots.
The inner lining of this coat follow the direction of the body's veins, allowing for easier magic channeling.
With these gloves, all the magic of the world can easily flow through you and into the tips of your fingers.
This magical spellbinder's hat has been adorned with an azure gem. It attracts lingering or scattered fragments of the Flame and stores them for improved spellcasting.
A pair of pants. They're breezier than they look, allowing you to feel the wind.
Allows for faster swim sprints while submerged in water.
ingredients_zh: 棕榈叶 x6、水爬虫皮革 x4、金币 x10、纸莎草 x4

desc: A well-fitted pair of boots to round off the Thaumaturge armor set. The purple accents create a balanced overall look.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、紫罗兰布料 x2、甲壳粉 x25

desc: This chest piece includes a silky white undergarment for warmth and a flowy cerulean cape for further insulation, and dramatic effect.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x6、保暖衬垫 x2、黄色布料 x7、紫水晶 x3、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: Elaborate armguards that shield the wearer from snow, rime, and grime. An amethyst has been inserted into the gem slot, enabling a better mana flow when spellcasting.
ingredients_zh: 紫水晶 x2、黑曜石 x2、保暖衬垫 x2、紫罗兰布料 x2、甲壳粉 x25

desc: An extravagantly exaggerated tricorn hat that shields the caster's head from snowfall. The imposing antlers are a wearable trophy representing the wearer's spirit animal.
ingredients_zh: 黑曜石 x3、保暖衬垫 x1、紫罗兰布料 x1、甲壳粉 x25

desc: This pair of pants has significant padding on the inside, allowing you to travel for longer periods in frost-ridden lands. Traditionally, hides from the wearer's spirit animal are used to create the padding, but wool will do in a pinch.
ingredients_zh: 保暖衬垫 x2、硬化皮革 x4、雾锁之冰 x50

desc: A very basic set of garments.
They don't offer much protection, but enhance your magical abilities. The minimalist design also prevents you from getting sweaty hands.
ingredients_zh: 鱼类象牙粉尘 x2、水豚鬃毛 x2、金粉 x5、蓝色布料 x2、被诅咒的迷雾囊 x1

desc: A striking, extravagant headpiece, just as broad as your magical abilities -- but you might get stuck in the doorway.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x1、鱼类象牙粉尘 x2、棕榈叶 x5、金粉 x1

desc: Those pants go perfectly with the tunic, creating a fluent transition. They allow enough air circulation to prevent overheating during battle.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x4、水爬虫皮革 x4、海蓝宝石粉末 x10、蓝色布料 x2、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: Stride forth in these shoes, as swiftly as your mana regenerates.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x2、蓝色布料 x2、海蓝宝石粉末 x10、雾霭污泥 x1

desc: A light tunic, as majestic in appearance as the powers it bestows when you spread your arms wide.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x4、海蓝宝石 x3、金锭 x2、橙色布料 x2、迸裂荒野之心 x1

desc: A wanderer's boots, worn but still sturdy enough to carry your burdens on your journey.
Traditional warlock boots which protect the feet and allow the wearer to stampede over enemy remains.
ingredients_zh: 化石骨 x4、衬垫 x2、木炭 x3、铁锭 x1、堕落镰刃之雾 x2

desc: Both spells and smiting blows are easily dealt with these marvelous warlock gloves.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x2、黄色布料 x2、衬垫 x2、木炭 x3、铁锭 x1、雾锁秃鹫之爪 x2

desc: A helmet which protects your sensitive cranial bone from harm while riding into battle.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x3、衬垫 x1、木炭 x3、铁锭 x1、堕落之心 x1

desc: Historic pants, formerly the centerpiece of ceremonial warlock clothing.
ingredients_zh: 黄色布料 x3、铁锭 x1、衬垫 x4、木炭 x3、易碎瘴气薄片 x25

desc: A traditional garment which was historically worn by esteemed battle mages. Now, their ritualistic nature is a faint memory at best.
ingredients_zh: 青金石 x3、黄色布料 x2、衬垫 x5、木炭 x4、铁锭 x2、堕落之心 x1

desc: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you -- can you feel it?
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x2、钢锭 x1、微光根粉尘 x10、雾霭污泥 x1

desc: Golden adornments define this set -- and naturally, the gloves are no exception.
ingredients_zh: 棕榈叶 x2、水豚鬃毛 x2、金粉 x5、鱼类象牙粉尘 x2、被诅咒的迷雾囊 x1

desc: The mask veils the face, but not the intent. You are here to keep one safe.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x1、金粉 x5、棕榈叶 x5、鱼牙 x2

desc: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer's presence to shine.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x4、粉色蘑菇肉 x50、海蓝宝石粉末 x10、蓝色布料 x2、腐化野猪獠牙 x1

desc: A magnificent aquamarine gleams upon this garment, said to amplify the wearer's healing abilities.
ingredients_zh: 水豚鬃毛 x4、海蓝宝石 x3、金锭 x2、蓝色布料 x2、迸裂荒野之心 x1

desc: Remain steadfast when smiting your foes from afar with these formidable wizard boots
Protects the wearer from stray sparks, sudden cold flashes, and unplanned fiery explosions.
A dark and dreary set of gloves. They make spellcasting feel ominous!
Some farmers believe that wizards store their magical energy in their brimmed hats. These rumors were widespread but false. Mostly.
Dark pants for dark magic wielders.
